_comment: Fields of the Addons product sheet, in the order of the Addons seller form. 'question' is the label in the form. 'scope': 'language' = docs/content/<iso>/marketing.json, 'common' = docs/docs.json > marketing (the same for every language). Addons does not publish length limits for these fields; the limits below are our own (long enough for a good text, short enough to stay readable). Lengths are counted in characters (mb_strlen) of the plain text.

description.question: Description of the module
description.hint: What the module does and why a merchant wants it: 2-5 short paragraphs, written for merchants, no technical jargon.

category.question: Category
category.hint: The one best-fitting category from resources/addons/categories.json.

logo_suggestion.question: Logo
logo_suggestion.hint: A concept for the logo (Addons: square PNG, 512 x 512 recommended): symbol, colours, style. Optionally draw it in docs/content/logo-suggestion.svg.

price.question: Price (excl. tax, EUR)
price.hint: A number between 49.99 and 4999.99, compared with similar modules on Addons.

features.question: What features are included in your module?
features.hint: One feature per item, benefit first, with the words merchants search for (SEO).

benefits.question: What are the benefits for the merchant?

multistore.question: Is your module multi-store compatible?
multistore.hint: Always "Fully": PrestaShopHeaven modules must work in every shop of a multistore.

installation_instructions.question: Detailed installation instructions
installation_instructions.hint: Step by step from download to a working configuration, including where to find the settings.

prerequisites.question: Prerequisites
prerequisites.hint: Ideally none (empty list). Only real requirements: an external account, an API key, a PHP extension.

anything_to_add.question: Anything to add?
anything_to_add.hint: Known incompatibilities, conflicts with other modules or themes, limitations, support. Write "No known incompatibilities." when there are none.

keywords.question: SEO keywords (not an Addons field: used to check the description and the features)
keywords.hint: The search terms merchants use in this language. Each one should occur in the description or the features.

screenshots._comment: Screenshots for the Addons product page, per language. Not confirmed by published Addons documentation (research: at least 3, at least 1000 x 1000 px, front office on Classic and Hummingbird and mobile): reported as a warning by 'docs build'.
